subject: Vessel Movement Plan for the next 48 Hrs. 10-May-2026
narrative:
All,

Please see the below Vessel Movement plan for next 48hrs.:


Allianz Juno…



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Shuaiba Port. Vessel will remain STBY at Shuaiba Port.
  *   Tomorrow 10th May, Vessel will sail 1st Run to Rig Oriental Phoenix via NSBP with Crew change pax, ETD 08.30hrs.
  *   Tomorrow 10th May, Vessel will sail 2nd Run to Rig Oriental Dragon with Crest Argus-1 Food containers, ETD 13.00hrs.
  *   Vessel will return to Shuaiba Port from Rig Oriental Dragon, Vessel will STBY at Berth-4.



 Crest Argus 1…



  *   Vessel currently STBY at Rig Oriental Dragon-1, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Dragon-1.
  *   Tomorrow 10th May, Vessel will remain STBY at Rig Oriental Dragon-1.


Crest Argus 3…



  *   Vessel currently STBY at Rig Oriental Phoenix, Vessel will STBY at Rig Oriental Phoenix.
  *   Tomorrow 10th May, Vessel will remain STBY at Rig Oriental Phoenix.



Crest Argus 5….



  *   Vessel currently enroute to Shuaiba Port, ETA at 20.40hrs., Vessel will remain STBY at Shuaiba Port.
  *   Tomorrow 10th May, Vessel will sail to Oriental Phoenix, ETD 14.00hrs.



Crew change details will be sent by Rig Logistics/ Aisha/ Ahmed Modather.



Gary,

Kindly approve the above Vessel Movement Plan.

Regards,
